# Fresh raw binary callback before superclass construction

Owned Java corpus for a descriptor-only child constructor passing null and a
fresh raw Callback<T,R> to two closed Callback<Object,Token> parameters. Callback
forwards its R formal to the unary Functor<R> marker. Every original class,
constructor and generic Signature remains unchanged. Four construction routes,
three consumers and sixteen modes observe initialization and sticky failures,
allocation publication, partial parent/child fields, long argument identity,
original exceptions, callback input/result identity and delayed result checks.
Source and immutable contract-JAR profiles compile every generated source.
No private sample code or data is included.
